evals.name: add-attachment
evals.prompt: I forgot to include the building enclosure photos PDF on this week's update email. Add `Building Enclosure Photos 2026-05-07.pdf` to the attachments list. The Schedules folder is at {SCHEDULES_PATH}. The dated folder for this week is `2026-05-07/`.
evals.expected_output: {YYYY-MM-DD}-email-preview.html with the new attachment row inserted via the generator. Existing attachments preserved. CRUD discipline strictly enforced (no Edit/Read/Write on the preview HTML).
expectations: The agent invoked parse_email_html (read-side of CRUD)
The agent invoked generate_email_preview_html (write-side of CRUD)
The agent did NOT use the Edit tool on the email-preview HTML
The agent did NOT use the Read tool on the email-preview HTML
The new attachment 'Building Enclosure Photos 2026-05-07.pdf' is present in the resulting attachments list
All three pre-existing attachments are preserved (Report 01, Procurement Tracker, Salt Flats Schedule)
Days-behind metric is unchanged (still 7)
